sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Implement AIChatbotService in Java with Spring Boot @Service annotation. Integrate with OpenAI API via secure HTTP client using encrypted credentials from application.yml. Enforce input validation: query must be non-empty and length < 1024 characters; reject malformed JSON. Implement exception handling: map ExternalServiceException to HTTP 502 and InvalidInputException to HTTP 400. Implement SLF4J logging with MDC for request ID and create an audit log entry for each response.

Coder Agent: Implement AIChatbotController with REST endpoint POST /api/chatbot/query consuming application/json. Secure with JWT authentication via @PreAuthorize; include optional role checks. Validate request DTO using Hibernate Validator, returning 400 Bad Request for errors. Response DTO must include fields: answer (String), confidence (Double), escalate (Boolean). Publish the response to Kafka topic 'chatbot.responses' for downstream analytics.

Tester Agent: Write unit tests for AIChatbotService using Mockito to mock the external AI client. Test scenarios: successful query response, low-confidence response triggering escalation, and external service exception. Verify input validation triggers InvalidInputException for empty or overly long queries. Assert that audit log entries are created for each response.

Reviewer Agent: Perform static code analysis on AIChatbotService using SpotBugs and OWASP Dependency Check; ensure no high-severity findings. Verify the service uses prepared statements for any database interactions (none in this service). Confirm exception handling aligns with the API contract, mapping ExternalServiceException to HTTP 502 and InvalidInputException to HTTP 400.

Doc Agent: Create README documentation for the AI Chatbot module. Include endpoint specification for POST /api/chatbot/query, request/response JSON examples, error codes (400, 502), and deployment notes. Reference GDPR data handling procedures for user queries.

Coder Agent: Implement MobileRoleSpecificUIService to return a JSON map of role → list of available screens. Source data from the 'roles' and 'role_screen_mapping' database tables (pre-populated). Cache results in Redis with a TTL of 5 minutes to meet latency SLA. Validate the role ID against the Roles table; throw InvalidRoleException if not found.

Coder Agent: Implement MobileRoleSpecificUIController with REST endpoint GET /api/mobile/ui/metadata requiring JWT authentication. Return HTTP 200 with JSON payload; return HTTP 404 if role not found. Log request and response details with a correlation ID.

Tester Agent: Write unit tests for MobileRoleSpecificUIService. Mock the repository to return sample role data. Test cache hit and cache miss scenarios. Verify that InvalidRoleException is thrown for an invalid role ID.
Reviewer Agent: Review MobileRoleSpecificUIService. Ensure no hard-coded role names; use the enum UserRole. Verify thread-safety of cache access mechanisms.
Doc Agent: Create README documentation for the Mobile UI module. Detail the API contract for GET /api/mobile/ui/metadata, the role mapping schema, and the caching strategy using Redis with TTL.

Coder Agent: Implement PushNotificationService using Firebase Admin SDK for FCM and the 'pushy' library for APNs. Persist notification records in the 'notifications' table with status flags: 'sent', 'failed'. Implement retry logic with exponential back-off up to 3 attempts; log each attempt. Publish notification events to Kafka topic 'notifications.push' for analytics.

Coder Agent: Implement PushNotificationController with REST endpoint POST /api/notifications/push consuming JSON payload with fields: userId (String), message (String), platform (String). Validate the 'platform' field against an enum of supported values; reject unsupported values. Return HTTP 202 Accepted; actual delivery must be handled asynchronously by the service.

Tester Agent: Write unit tests for PushNotificationService. Mock FCM and APNs clients. Test scenarios: successful delivery, delivery failure, and retry path. Verify database record creation and status updates (sent/failed).

Reviewer Agent: Review PushNotificationService. Perform static analysis for null-pointer safety. Verify OWASP CSRF mitigation via @CrossOrigin restrictions. Confirm the retry schedule (exponential back-off, max 3 attempts) complies with NFR-004 scaling requirements.
Doc Agent: Create README documentation for the Notifications module. Include API specification for POST /api/notifications/push, retry policy details, and failure handling guidelines.

Docker Agent: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile for backend services. Use base image 'openjdk:17-jdk-slim'. Compile with Maven and copy the resulting JAR to 'app.jar'. Set ENTRYPOINT ['java','-jar','/app.jar']. Expose port 8080. Implement a health-check endpoint at '/actuator/health'. Ensure final image size is < 500 MB.

Gcp Agent: Create GKE deployment manifest. Configure Deployment with 3 replicas and Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) based on CPU > 70% or latency > 300 ms. Define Service type ClusterIP exposing port 8080. Create ConfigMap for application.yml and Secret for FCM credentials. Enable readinessProbe and livenessProbe with 30-second intervals.
